# filename: compute_oldest_bluray.py
import pandas as pd

file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

section['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(section['Year'], errors='coerce')
print(section[['Title', 'Year']])

min_year = section['Year'].min()
oldest = section[section['Year'] == min_year]['Title']
print("Min year:", min_year)
print("Oldest titles:")
print(oldest)
